beats.say: Time to get dressed! My sock!
I'll put it on my antenna!
Socks are not for your antenna!
Socks go on your feet. Then your shoes!
Did you know? Each foot has twenty six bones!
What color are your socks today?

sources.fact: The human foot consists of 26 bones in total (7 tarsals, 5 metatarsals, 14 phalanges)
